params.caption: 60-second Deep Melodic House track in a 6/8 time signature. Features a driving, triplet-based 'rolling' rhythm with a heavy kick on the downbeat and crisp, organic percussion. Incorporate lush, side-chained atmospheric pads and a delicate, melancholic synth pluck melody. The vocals are minimal, intimate, and processed with wide stereo delays and pitch-shifted echoes. The aesthetic is a blend of Ben Böhmer's melodic depth and Fred again..'s atmospheric texture. Fast structural progression: immediate beat entry, 25-second melodic build, and a brief 5-second ambient fade-out.
params.lyrics:
(Immediate rolling 6/8 percussion: Kick-kick-snare, Kick-kick-snare)
(Sub-bass follows the 6/8 pulse)

(Vocal - Breathy, heavily delayed)
Stay...
Just for the rhythm.
(Echo: For the rhythm...)
In the silence.

(Lush, side-chained chords swell on every first beat of the 6/8 bar)
(High-pitched synth "plucks" dancing in triplets)

(Drums cut, leaving one long reverb wash)
(Faint whisper: "Now.")
